name: Urolithin A
summary: Urolithin A is a gut-microbiome-derived metabolite produced from ellagitannin and ellagic-acid precursors. Several short randomized human trials have tested supplemental urolithin A for skeletal-muscle and mitochondrial-health outcomes, with some favorable secondary strength or endurance signals but mixed primary outcomes. This profile remains research-only while replication, sponsor independence, long-term safety, and outcome-specific certainty are reviewed.
description: Canonical urolithin A research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until the site's structured review reconciles randomized trials, the 2026 systematic review, product-specific evidence, conflicts of interest, and long-term safety limits.
primary_effects_or_targets: mitophagy-associated signaling; mitochondrial quality control; skeletal-muscle performance
